intent: This is the season's warmest episode, and its most dangerous. It gives room for: a confession: Gus's, in the co-op variant; a reconciliation: Margaux and Marchand, or Gus and Marin; a kiss or a pact: Lila, at midnight. Then Margaux turns the whole season with one word, «fatiguée». She has been the season's quiet centre, and now she asks for nothing. That is what makes the choice about the flat a real choice. It is no longer about being «for» or «against» the café.
state_in: From gap 6. Christmas at Le Mistral: Marchand's two croissants, and Lila's present. The plan has been prepared but not attempted. Lila's crate has left for Berlin by freight. She has a suitcase and a date: 8 January, 9:55.

movements.visual: Le Mistral dressed for the Réveillon: one long table, paper stars, and Gus's candelabra. By the menu board, Romy and Marin argue with chalk in hand. Gus, in a dinner jacket, lays out place cards. Lila, on a chair, hangs the last star.

native.de: 31. Dezember. Das Mistral feiert Silvester. Vielleicht das letzte.

native.de: Bei uns ist le souper am Abend!

native.en: And le dîner, then?

native.de: Guten Abend. Ich wurde eingeladen. Nun… Gus hat mich eingeladen. Im September mochte er mich nicht.

native.de: Neun Jahre. Dieselbe Miete. Ich verkaufe meine Stockwerke an Solvel. Nicht die Mauern des Cafés. Mit Ihrer Miete bezahle ich meine Seniorenresidenz. Das ist kein Geschenk. Das ist eine Rechnung.

native.en: No.
native.de: Nein.

movements.visual: Marin stands on a chair with a tally sheet, and the room crowds around him. In the booth's corner seat, Gus sits with his arms crossed, in a dinner jacket.

say.b1: Cent quatre-vingt-sept sociétaires ! Il en manque treize. Si on franchit minuit à deux cents, ce sera un signe.

native.de: Hundertsiebenundachtzig! Es fehlen dreizehn Personen. Wenn wir um Mitternacht bei zweihundert sind… ist das ein Zeichen.

native.de: Hundertsiebenundachtzig… Ist das nicht die Zahl von Gus' Petition?

Marin looks at Toi from his chair, then at Gus. He cannot ask, again.

interlude.note: After objection 3, Gus's confession. It always comes here, whatever the learner said. This is where the canon tentpole «Gus's aristocracy exposed» pays off, and it is not a humiliation. He tells it himself, to save the room.

interlude.visual: The room has heard. Marin sits down on his chair very slowly.
Lila gets up, puts the Polaroid on the table and sits down again without a word.

native.en: Keep the flat
native.de: Die Wohnung behalten

subtitle.a2: Tu habites au-dessus d'un café qui ferme.

native.en: You live above a café that is closing.
native.de: Du wohnst über einem Café, das schließt.

native.en: Sell it to the co-op
native.de: Sie an die Genossenschaft verkaufen

subtitle.a2: L'appartement devient l'atelier de tous. Là-haut, ce n'est plus chez toi.

native.en: The flat becomes everyone's workshop. Up there, it is no longer your home.
native.de: Die Wohnung wird zur Werkstatt für alle. Dort oben bist du nicht mehr zu Hause.

native.en: Sell it to Solvel
native.de: Sie an Solvel verkaufen

subtitle.a2: Tu paies le feu. Margaux est libre. Le Mistral ferme le 7 janvier.

native.en: You pay for the fire. Margaux is free. Le Mistral closes on 7 January.
native.de: Du bezahlst das Feuer. Margaux ist frei. Das Mistral schließt am 7. Januar.

movements.visual: 9 a.m. The canal on New Year's Day, the city empty. Toi walks alone along the quai de Valmy. One pigeon, one jogger, and the locks.
movements.note: Note on Le choix: if the lease is signed and the learner still chooses «sell», the café stays open on the lease under Solvel's upper floors. This folds into ending 3's emotional shape, with Margaux choosing to close anyway, because she is tired and now can. The writers accept this fold. The owner may prefer to hide «sell» once the lease is signed (open question).

movements.visual: Back in the booth, the sleepers wake. Marin sits up, sees the folder in his arms and remembers.

say.a2: On a… On a gagné ? On a perdu ?

native.en: Did we… Did we win? Did we lose?
native.de: Haben wir… Haben wir gewonnen? Haben wir verloren?

say.a2: Mon cher, on a surtout trop bu.

native.en: My dear fellow, mostly we drank too much.
native.de: Mein Lieber, wir haben vor allem zu viel getrunken.

panel.visual: Odile's flat. On the kitchen wall, her calendar is still stopped on April 2023. Beside it, Toi pins a new calendar, January 2027, and circles one date in pen: 8. The two calendars hang side by side.

say.a2: Dans sept jours : le train de Lila. La fin de l'offre. Et tout le reste. À suivre…
say.b1: Dans sept jours : le train de Lila, la fin de l'offre de Solvel, et tout ce qu'on n'a pas encore dit. À suivre…

native.en: In seven days: Lila's train. The end of the offer. And everything else. To be continued…
native.de: In sieben Tagen: Lilas Zug. Das Ende des Angebots. Und alles andere. Fortsetzung folgt…

panel.note: The learner turns the time capsule's clock forward. It is the season's quietest meaningful change.

for_next_gap: The decision is made. The week is about «last times», not about reversing it.
Nobody finds the letter before T8.
